item.title: Brightstar Resources Lifts Mineral Resource at Menzies Project by 22%
item.description: Brightstar Resources (ASX: BTR) has increased the MRE at its Menzies gold project following infill and extensional drilling undertaken during 2025, delivering a 22% increase in total contained gold to 0.7 million ounces at 1.5 grams per tonne.

item.title: Metals Powder Works Produces High-Purity Silver Powder Using Patented New Process
item.description: Metal Powder Works (ASX: MPW) has expanded its specialty materials portfolio with the production of high-purity silver powder utilising its patented DirectPowder process.

item.title: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Identifies 90 New Drug-Combination Candidates from AlgoraeOS V2 Analysis
item.description: Algorae Pharmaceuticals (ASX: 1AI) has identified 90 high-quality drug-combination candidates following a preliminary review of newly delivered in silico synergy predictions generated by its upgraded AlgoraeOS v2 platform.

item.title: Askari Metals Setting Itself Up for an Active 2026 at the Nejo Project in Ethiopia
item.description: Askari Metals (ASX: AS2) is finalising preparations for a significant drilling campaign in 2026 at its new Nejo project in Ethiopia, with executive director Gino D’Anna meeting with key stakeholders to finalise approvals for a Phase 1 drilling program at the project.

item.title: Metallium Secures Strategic Role in US Red-Mud Program to Produce Gallium and Scandium
item.description: Metallium (ASX: MTM) has executed a binding Letter of Intent with ElementUSA to deploy its Flash Joule Heating technology in a new program targeting gallium and scandium recovery from red-mud waste in Louisiana.

item.title: Hazer Group to Collaborate on Whyalla Clean Steel Bid with M Resources Partnership
item.description: Hazer Group (ASX: HZR) has entered a binding memorandum of understanding with M Resources to supply low-cost clean hydrogen and graphite technology for the proposed acquisition of the Whyalla steelworks in South Australia.

item.title: Lion Rock Minerals Delivers Further High-Grade Rutile Results from Minta Project
item.description: Lion Rock Minerals (ASX: LRM) has announced additional high-grade rutile results from its Minta rutile and monazite project in Cameroon, with in-situ rutile grades reaching up to 1.8% and several results exceeding 1% from residual targets across the project area.

item.title: Tesoro Gold Maiden Drilling Confirms Significant Gold System at El Zorro’s La Brea Target
item.description: Tesoro Gold (ASX: TSO) has reported assay results from a maiden diamond drilling program at the La Brea target within its El Zorro gold project in Chile, with all five holes intersecting favourable geology and wide alteration zones containing anomalous gold.

item.title: GreenX Metals Acquires 90% Interest in Tannenberg Copper Project
item.description: GreenX Metals (ASX: GRX) has completed its 90% acquisition of Group 11 Exploration, holder of the exploration licences for the Tannenberg copper project in Germany.

item.title: Weekly Wrap: ASX Climbs on Santa Rally as Miners and Gold Stocks Lead Gains
item.description: The Santa rally arrived in earnest on the Australian stock exchange as the share market rose the most in almost three weeks on Friday. A continuing rise in gold stocks and strong gains in miners happened as investors jumped aboard the US interest cuts train, hoping that it was creating a rising market tide that would lift all boats.
